name: Invoice Match Agent
fn: 5-layer matching: deterministic → fuzzy → ML → parent-child → agent investigation
detail: Runs each payment through a five-layer waterfall — deterministic, fuzzy, ML pattern, parent-child hierarchy and LLM investigation — stopping at the first confident match. Lifts straight-through match rates from the low-50s to 85%+ and shrinks the exception queue.
sap: SAP FI-AR (open items, F-28 / F-32 clearing) · FI-BL bank statements (FF67, BAI2 / MT940) · BAPI_ACC_DOCUMENT_POST

io.in: Remittances · bank files (BAI2/MT940) · FI-AR open items
